in_arabic.name: Bullah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Bullah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'بلّ', which means 'bull' in English. It is a name given to boys to symbolize strength, power, and courage, just like the animal it is named after.
